mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_admin_jobs(id,tenant_id,member_id,handler,operation,input_file_id,options_json,idempotency_key,request_digest,total_rows,state) VALUES(#{id},#{tenantId},#{memberId},#{handler},#{operation},#{inputFileId},#{optionsJson}::jsonb,#{idempotencyKey},#{requestDigest},#{totalRows},'queued') ON CONFLICT(scope_key,idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM nw_foundation_admin_jobs WHERE idempotency_key=#{key} AND scope_key= FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM nw_foundation_admin_jobs WHERE id=#{id} AND scope_key= FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM nw_foundation_admin_jobs WHERE id=#{id} AND scope_key=

SELECT id,handler,operation,state,total_rows,completed_rows,error_rows,error_message,result_file_id,created_at,expires_at FROM nw_foundation_admin_jobs WHERE scope_key= ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{size}
SELECT count(*) FROM nw_foundation_admin_jobs WHERE scope_key=

WITH candidate AS (SELECT id FROM nw_foundation_admin_jobs WHERE (state='queued' OR (state IN('running','cancel_requested') AND lease_until < now())) AND (CASE current_setting('app.foundation_jobs_dispatch',true) WHEN 'platform' THEN tenant_id IS NULL WHEN 'tenant' THEN tenant_id IS NOT NULL ELSE FALSE END) ORDER BY created_at,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) UPDATE nw_foundation_admin_jobs j SET state=CASE WHEN j.state='cancel_requested' THEN 'cancel_requested' ELSE 'running' END,lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=now()+interval '2 minutes',updated_at=now() FROM candidate c WHERE j.id=c.id RETURNING j.*

WITH locked AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,scope_key,lease_until,lease_owner,state FROM nw_foundation_admin_jobs WHERE id=#{id} AND scope_key= FOR UPDATE), valid AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM locked WHERE lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND state='running'), renewed AS (UPDATE nw_foundation_admin_jobs j SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '2 minutes' FROM valid v WHERE j.id=v.id AND v.lease_until<clock_timestamp()+interval '1 minute' RETURNING j.id) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM valid)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_admin_job_receipt_blocks WHERE job_id=#{id} AND block_number=(#{row}-2)/256 AND scope_key= AND get_bit(completed_bits,(#{row}-2)%256)=1)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_admin_job_receipt_blocks(job_id,scope_key,block_number,completed_bits) SELECT id,scope_key,(#{row}-2)/256,set_bit(decode(repeat('00',32),'hex'),(#{row}-2)%256,1) FROM nw_foundation_admin_jobs WHERE id=#{id} AND scope_key= AND #{row} BETWEEN 2 AND 10001 ON CONFLICT(job_id,block_number) DO UPDATE SET completed_bits=set_bit(nw_foundation_admin_job_receipt_blocks.completed_bits,(#{row}-2)%256,1) WHERE nw_foundation_admin_job_receipt_blocks.scope_key=excluded.scope_key AND get_bit(nw_foundation_admin_job_receipt_blocks.completed_bits,(#{row}-2)%256)=0

INSERT INTO nw_foundation_admin_job_rows(job_id,scope_key,row_number,errors_json) SELECT id,scope_key,#{row},#{errorsJson}::jsonb FROM nw_foundation_admin_jobs WHERE id=#{id} AND scope_key= ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: WITH totals AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT sum(bit_count(completed_bits)) FROM nw_foundation_admin_job_receipt_blocks WHERE job_id=#{id} AND scope_key=),0)::integer completed,(SELECT count(*) FROM nw_foundation_admin_job_rows WHERE job_id=#{id} AND scope_key=)::integer errors) UPDATE nw_foundation_admin_jobs j SET completed_rows=t.completed,error_rows=t.errors,updated_at=now() FROM totals t WHERE j.id=#{id} AND j.scope_key= AND j.lease_owner=#{owner} AND j.lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND j.state IN('running','cancel_requested') AND (j.completed_rows,j.error_rows) IS DISTINCT FROM (t.completed,t.errors)

UPDATE nw_foundation_admin_jobs SET state=#{state},error_message=#{message},result_file_id=#{resultFileId},total_rows=#{total},completed_rows=CASE WHEN operation='export' AND #{state}='succeeded' THEN #{total} ELSE completed_rows END,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,expires_at=now()+interval '7 days',updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND scope_key= AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until>now() AND state IN('running','cancel_requested')

UPDATE nw_foundation_admin_jobs SET state=CASE WHEN state='queued' THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'cancel_requested' END,expires_at=CASE WHEN state='queued' THEN now()+interval '7 days' ELSE NULL END,updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND scope_key= AND state IN('queued','running')
mapper.select: SELECT errors_json::text FROM nw_foundation_admin_job_rows WHERE job_id=#{id} AND scope_key= AND jsonb_array_length(errors_json)>0 ORDER BY row_number OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{size}

SELECT * FROM nw_foundation_admin_jobs WHERE state IN('succeeded','failed','cancelled') AND expires_at<now() AND (CASE current_setting('app.foundation_jobs_dispatch',true) WHEN 'platform' THEN tenant_id IS NULL WHEN 'tenant' THEN tenant_id IS NOT NULL ELSE FALSE END) ORDER BY expires_at,id LIMIT #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_admin_jobs SET state='expired',input_file_id=NULL,result_file_id=NULL,options_json='{}'::jsonb,error_message=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND scope_key= AND state IN('succeeded','failed','cancelled') AND expires_at<now()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM nw_foundation_admin_job_rows WHERE job_id=#{id} AND scope_key=
